exposure: Mode of conception (unassisted, subfertility, ovulation induction [OI] or intrauterine insemination [IUI], in vitro fertilization [IVF] or intracytoplasmic sperm injection [ICSI])
Preterm birth at less than 37 weeks
cohort: 1,370,152 singleton and multifetal live births in Ontario, Canada, from 2006 to 2018
finding: Children born to individuals with infertility had a slightly higher risk of autism spectrum disorder, which appears partly mediated by obstetrical and neonatal factors such as cesarean birth, multifetal pregnancy, preterm birth, and severe neonatal morbidity.
